title: Lemonade Change
description: Determine if you can provide correct change to every customer given $5, $10, and $20 bills, starting with no money.
pseudocode:
1. five = 0, ten = 0
2. for bill in bills:
3.   if bill == 5: five++
4.   else if bill == 10:
5.     if five < 1: return false
6.     five--, ten++
7.   else:
8.     if ten > 0 and five > 0: ten--, five--
9.     else if five >= 3: five -= 3
10.    else: return false

steps.note: Customer pays $20, need $15 change. Use one $10 and one $5.
